tags.description: The sculpture titled, "Growing Progress" was created and installed in 2016 by Michigan artist, Thomas Sheerin and is made entirely of repurposed metal. You can find the sculpture on the corner of West Jefferson and Harrison Streets in downtown Grand Ledge
tags.name: "Growing Progress"
